name: – Nacho Sánchez Amor – Motion for a resolution (as a whole)
title: REPORT on the 2025 Commission report on Türkiye
part_text:
The European Parliament says Türkiye's bid to join the European Union cannot restart while democracy, the rule of law and human rights keep getting worse there. It asks Türkiye to free jailed politicians, journalists and activists, stop removing elected mayors from office, and respect court rulings. It also wants the European Union to keep working with Türkiye on trade, migration and security, but to speak out publicly about the crackdown. The report is the Parliament's opinion; it does not change any law by itself.

- Nothing changes in law yet; Parliament only states its position and calls for action.
- It affects Türkiye's government, jailed opposition figures, journalists, mayors and civil society.
- Next, the text goes to European Union leaders and to Türkiye's president, government and parliament.
